newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African shares end strong on futures trade, rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African shares end strong on futures trade, rand.

text.p: South African industrial shares ended strong on futures-related activity and positive sentiment from a strong rand. Golds were firm, ignoring a static bullion price.
Traders said futures players were taking positions ahead of the mid-month close-out.
"Futures traders have been active. We have seen some aggressive buying of the physical equity. They are starting to position themselves for the close-out in the middle of the month," a trader said.
Traders said gold shares had been much slower to rise.
Overall index was 45.6 points stronger at 6,735 points, the industrial index rose 76.2 points to 7,911.8 points and the gold index was up 12.4 points to 1,800 points.
